name: netmedia-net8-to-net10-upgrade
description: Upgrades and modernizes a .NET 8 solution to .NET 10 LTS through six gated phases - class libraries, ASP.NET Core Web APIs, MVC/Razor/Blazor websites, Azure Functions and EF Core - then rewrites the code to current .NET 10 idioms. Includes a solution scanner that reports every known upgrade blocker before any code is touched.
